_meta: 인도네시아어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명 instruct 는 영어).
base_text: Sore ini saya ada rapat, jadi semua bahan sudah saya siapkan dari tadi pagi. Nanti kalau sudah selesai, kita makan malam bersama, ya?

am.desc: A young Indonesian man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice

af.desc: A young Indonesian woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice

ayu.desc: An Indonesian woman in her early twenties, bright, sweet and playful voice

raka.desc: An Indonesian man in his mid twenties, relaxed, friendly and slightly deep voice

nadia.desc: An Indonesian woman in her twenties, quick, lively and clever voice

dimas.desc: An Indonesian man in his early thirties, steady, polite and slightly dry voice

busri.desc: An Indonesian woman in her forties, warm, brisk and motherly voice

darto.desc: An Indonesian man in his fifties, cheerful, slightly husky and talkative voice

man_y.desc: An Indonesian man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: An Indonesian man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: An Indonesian man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: An Indonesian woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: An Indonesian woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: An Indonesian woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: An Indonesian child around eight years old, small and bright voice

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice, like a station or airport announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

neutral.ref: Sore ini saya ada rapat, jadi bahan-bahannya saya siapkan dulu.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: Selamat siang, Bu. Pesanan Ibu sudah siap. Silakan dinikmati.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: Terima kasih banyak atas waktunya. Saya akan berusaha sebaik mungkin. Mohon bimbingannya.

cheerful.ref: Eh, kamu sudah datang! Cuacanya bagus sekali, hari ini pasti menyenangkan.

amused.ref: Haha, lucu sekali! Bagus, teruskan saja seperti itu.

teasing.ref: Kenapa mukamu begitu? Ayo, jujur saja. Saya tidak akan bilang siapa-siapa.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: Berhasil, saya berhasil! Saya sendiri sampai kaget. Terima kasih banyak!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: Hah? Serius? Tunggu sebentar, apa maksudnya?

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort
shout.ref: Apa? Sekarang? Kalau mendadak begini, saya harus bagaimana!

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: Bukan begitu! Kenapa malah di situ, sih? Aduh, kamu ini.

annoyed.ref: Aduh, itu lagi? Sudah cukup, jangan dibahas terus.

sad.ref: Saya cuma agak capek. Tidak apa-apa. Jangan dipikirkan.

worried.ref: Kamu tidak apa-apa? Sakit, ya? Apa tidak sebaiknya ke dokter?

flustered.ref: Eh, anu, itu, sebentar... saya tidak tahu harus bilang apa...

shy.ref: Ah... itu... saya juga suka. Jadi... ayo pergi bersama.

gentle.ref: Tidak apa-apa. Pelan-pelan saja. Saya ada di sini.
